The main takeaway from our work is that
the spectral evolution of Swift GRBs can be accurately tracked, and that this is important for understanding the temporal and spectral properties of the prompt emission.
spectral evolution is a significant effect in Swift GRB light curves, and that it is important to take this into account when analysing Swift light curves.
